summary: Engineering workstation ws-eng01 is very likely compromised and is using the stolen eng.mokoa token to attempt lateral movement toward ws-eng02, jump01 and the domain admin account, while sending data to an external host.

findings.claim: 198.51.100.77 is command-and-control and a data exfiltration target
The eng.mokoa credential is stolen and in use
evidence: Kerberos request from an unusual process

findings.claim: Lateral movement is in progress toward IT hosts and privileged credentials
No evidence yet that the cooling PLC or HMI has been touched

open_questions: Is svc-cool-poll also exposed on ws-eng01?
Has jump01 been accessed beyond the RDP session?
